artworks.title: Two Marquesans [verso]
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch depicting two individuals from the shoulders up. The person in the foreground is in profile facing the right side of the image, with soft facial features, prominent eyelashes, and an aquiline nose. Their hair is long and flows down their back, with floral adornments nestled within it. The person in the background is positioned behind the first, with a three-quarter view visible, showing slightly closed eyes and a neutral expression. The background features lightly sketched lines and a suggestion of abstract shapes or figures, creating a textured appearance without distinct detailing.

artworks.title: Two Figures
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 15.2 x 8.8 cm (6 x 3 7/16 in.)
support: 23.8 x 17.3 cm (9 3/8 x 6 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures sketched on aged paper. The woman is depicted from the waist up, turned slightly to the right. She has shoulder-length hair and wears a draped headdress. The child, positioned beside the woman, faces slightly to the right with detailed facial features and short, wavy hair. Both figures wear draped robes and are surrounded by a textured background with small spots.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person seated with one leg extended on a chair, drawing or writing on a pad or canvas. The person is depicted in profile with defined facial features, curly hair tied back, dressed in artist attire. Their hands are busy sketching with a drawing tool. Artistic materials surround them, like a palette and brush, in an artist's studio setting. A pedestal with a bust is nearby. In the background, human figures are seen in an architectural setting with arches and columns.

artworks.title: The Blenheim, Leaving the Star Hotel, Oxford
artworks.artist: Frederick James Havell after George Havell
artworks.description: This is a painting of a stagecoach scene with an ornate stagecoach, harnessed to four horses, parked in front of a brick building. The scene is lively, with various individuals around the coach carrying passengers and packages. The architecture and attire suggest it is from the 19th century, featuring vibrant colors and detailed representations typical of that period.

artworks.title: Macaw on a Pine Branch
artworks.description: A parrot with red and green feathers is perched on a brown tree branch. The image has a color palette of reds, greens, browns, and a light tan background. The parrot is in the center of the branch, which runs diagonally from the bottom left corner to the top right. Foliage is concentrated on the sides. Vertical script is on the left, and horizontal script is in the upper right of the background.

artworks.title: Ye Olde Curiosity Shop
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an old shopfront titled "Ye Olde Curiosity Shop." The artwork depicts a building with a pitched roof, multiple windows, and various objects displayed on ledges and in window displays. The shop sign is clearly visible, and the scene includes hanging pictures, shelves with items, and an open entrance. The drawing shows textures and shading that highlight the building's structure and details within the scene.

artworks.title: Exocetus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two species of flying fish, along with detailed illustrations of their facial features. The drawing includes two main depictions of fish labeled as "1" and "2", with each showing intricate details of the fish's scales and fins, highlighting their distinctive wings which resemble those of an insect. Above and below these two main illustrations, diagrams labeled "a" and "b" provide close-up views of the fish's head and facial features. The species are titled "Exocetus," with specific identifications of "1. E. Nuthalii" and "2. E. Fasciatus" written below the images. The drawing is rendered in fine lines and shading on a textured background.

artworks.title: Lebia (L'Ellipsoidea)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fish species labeled "Lebia" with anatomical details. It includes a lateral view labeled "1" and a dorsal view labeled "2", along with detailed sketches of specific anatomical features labeled "3" and "4". The lateral view shows the fish with scales, fins, and body shape detailed, while the dorsal view gives an understanding of the fish's top profile and fin positioning. The illustration provides details for the study of ichthyology, including the species name and specific variety "L. Ellipsoidea." The drawing is likely created for academic or research purposes.

artworks.title: C. Macrolepidotus
artworks.description: The image depicts a black and white illustration of a fish labeled as "C. Macrolepidotus." The fish has scales covering its body, a forked tail, and distinct fins. The color palette is monochrome with varying shades of black and white. To the left, there is a smaller illustration of the fish's mouth, and to the right, there is a smaller illustration of part of its fin. The fish is positioned horizontally across the central section of the image on a plain background.

artworks.title: Lepus Palustris
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a hare in its natural habitat. The image shows a hare lying on a textured ground surrounded by grasses. The drawing is detailed, depicting the fur texture of the hare and lines of surrounding plants. The background is minimal to highlight the hare. The work is presented in monochrome with precision, and the species name "Lepus palustris" is written beneath the illustration.

artworks.title: Doncaster Races: The Horses Starting for the Great St. Ledger Stakes
artworks.description: The scene depicts the Doncaster Races, showing the racecourse from a slightly elevated perspective. The sky is filled with soft clouds and the horizon appears low. A grand building, possibly the grandstand, is on the left. Spectators are gathered along the fence and within the race track. Horses and riders are racing towards the right. The brushstrokes are fine and detailed. The color palette is warm and natural, with earthy greens and browns dominating. The jockeys' attire is vibrant reds and blues, contrasting with the muted colors of the spectators' clothing. The track narrows in the distance, leading to the vanishing point on the right where it meets trees and low hills on the horizon.

artworks.title: Doncaster Race for the Great St. Legder Stakes
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a horse race with spectators along the track. A grandstand and other buildings are present, and the scene is depicted with detailed brushstrokes and refined colors.

artworks.title: The Royal Mails Departure from the General Post Office, London
artworks.description: The image features a busy street scene outside a grand building that appears to be an official structure. The title "The Royal Mail Departure From The General Post Office, London" is displayed at the bottom. The perspective is eye-level, showing the front of the post office with classical architectural elements such as tall columns and a pediment. The building dominates the middle of the image, with the horizon visible above. There is a mix of human activity and horse-drawn carriages, creating a lively atmosphere. The scene is depicted in soft, muted tones with a warm color palette, while the carriage wheels and horse coats offer deeper colors and detail. The artwork appears detailed and delicately rendered, capturing a historical moment with precision.

artworks.title: Christ Presented to the People: Oblong Plate
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 34.8 x 45.3 cm (13 11/16 x 17 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical or biblical scene with a large gathering of people in a public space. The image depicts an elevated platform where several figures are standing, surrounded by an audience below. Architectural elements surround the scene, featuring columns and windows, hinting at a historical or Roman setting. Detailed line work captures the crowd in various states of engagement, some appearing to discuss or observe, others gesturing.

artworks.title: Faust
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person leaning forward with one hand resting on a large book or flat surface. The person is positioned side-on to the viewer, facing a window on the right through which a bright light emanates, illuminating part of their face and upper body. Their face features a prominent nose and chin, and they have a contemplative expression. The person's hair is mostly covered by a turban or cloth wrapped around their head, with some short hair visible. They are wearing a long robe with textured patterns and layers. On the table, there appear to be scientific or astrological instruments, such as a compass and charts. The surrounding room is dimly lit, with shelves and possibly other materials or equipment partly visible in the background. A bust or sculpture is positioned behind the person. A large window with an intricate arch design is the focal point of the background, with the source of light giving the impression of some form of revelation or enlightenment.

artworks.title: Jan Asselijn
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man sitting down. He is slightly oriented to the right but facing the viewer. The man has a mustache, long, wavy hair, and a calm expression. He is wearing a wide-brimmed hat and a dark, heavy coat with a visible collar. His right arm rests on books placed on a table beside him. The background is plain with a light color and some texture.

artworks.title: Jan Lutma
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an older man seated in an armchair. He has short hair and a beard, with a neutral expression. He is wearing a detailed robe or coat and is holding an object, possibly a cane. The chair has lion head decorative elements. In the background, there are items on a table.

artworks.title: Bust of a Young Woman (Jeune femme en buste)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a woman's body in a three-quarter view. Her head is slightly tilted to the left with a faint smile. Her facial features are soft and delicate, and her hair is styled with waves, partly covered by an elaborate hat with feathers or fabric. She wears a gown with ruffle details at the neckline and sleeves, with arms crossed over her chest. The drawing is against a plain, shaded background.

artworks.title: Frontispiece
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green, blue, and orange
artworks.description: The image depicts a person adjusting a yellow-orange hat while standing. They wear a long blue dress with puffed sleeves and a white collar. The person has blonde hair and the background is a light neutral tone. In the background, there are partial sketches of a table and a top hat. Text on the left side reads "ELLES par" along with a logo.

artworks.title: Woman with a Tray (Femme au plateau)
artworks.description: The image shows two people. On the left, there is an older woman holding a tray with a cup and saucer. She has curly hair and a thoughtful expression, wearing a loose garment. On the right, a person is lying in bed, covered up to the chest with a blanket. They have long, straight hair and rest on pillows. The background includes a headboard and minimal room details.

artworks.title: Woman Waking Up in Bed (Femme Couchée, Réveil)
artworks.description: The image is a soft pencil sketch showing two people lying in bed. One person is turned towards the other, resting their head on the other's shoulder or upper chest. The person facing the viewer has tender facial features and long, dark hair. Both individuals wear loose clothing, possibly nightwear. The other person's face is not visible as it is turned away. The bed is detailed with textured bedding and pillows, and the background is minimally sketched.

artworks.title: Woman Washing Herself (Femme qui se lave)
artworks.medium: color lithograph on thin wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a woman's body from behind. She is bending forward with her left hand in a basin and her right arm raised towards her back. Her head is tilted downwards, her hair is styled loosely and tied back at the nape of her neck. The woman appears to be wearing a light garment or cloth draped around her lower body, while her back is bare. Various indistinct objects are around the basin along with cabinetry and artwork on the wall.

artworks.title: Woman at the Mirror (Femme à glace)
artworks.medium: lithograph in gray, yellow, and beige
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the back, with her torso and upper legs visible. She stands in a relaxed position, turned slightly to her right. Her hair is dark and styled in a loose bun, with a small ribbon or bow visible at the top of her head. She is wearing a light-colored flowing garment that drapes over her shoulders. The woman is holding a hand mirror in her left hand. The scene is set in a bedroom with soft furnishings, including a bed with pillows, a draped curtain, a chair or cushion with patterned fabric, a mantelpiece with an ornate figure, and golden slippers on the floor.
